name: Cancer Research UK
what: UK charity funding research into more than 200 types of cancer.

name: AACR Foundation
what: Fundraising arm of the American Association for Cancer Research; funds research grants.

name: Deutsche Krebshilfe
what: German cancer charity funding research projects, patient advice and a hardship fund.

name: St. Jude Children's Research Hospital
what: Researches and treats childhood cancer; families never receive a bill for treatment.

name: Fondation ARC
what: French foundation funding cancer research; over 3,700 projects funded since 2012.

name: Worldwide Cancer Research
what: Funds early-stage discovery research into cancer by scientists anywhere in the world.

name: Folding@home
what: Donate spare computer time to protein simulations, including cancer work on KRas and BRCA1.
